primitives.name: Self-Audit Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # OPERATION FULL-COURT PRESS — PHASE IV: FIND THE GAPS, BUILD THE ARSENAL ## Self-critique everything.
primitives.assumptions: Operator is a fixed-point in recursive self-evaluation; all prior outputs are subject to re-assessment.

layer2.mapping: Dual process: \( \mathcal{O}_{\text{audit}} = \mathcal{O}_{\text{output}} \circ \mathcal{F}_{\text{gap}} \), where \( \mathcal{F}_{\text{gap}} \) is the gap-finding functional.
layer2.telemetry: Internal consistency score between prior and current phase outputs.

primitives.name: Open Source Arsenal
primitives.verbatim_quote: Phase IV does two things your earlier phases did not: (1) it audits YOUR OWN prior output for gaps, blind spots, and shallow work, and (2) it finds the actual open-source weaponry — 20 repositories — evaluated for real, with integration specs.
primitives.assumptions: Each repository \( r_i \in \mathcal{R} \) is independently evaluated for utility and maintainability.

layer2.mapping: Arsenal kernel \( \mathcal{K}(\mathcal{R}) = \prod_{r_i \in \mathcal{R}} \text{IntegrationSpec}(r_i) \cdot \text{CommercialUse}(r_i) \), where \( \mathcal{K} \) defines operational readiness.
layer2.telemetry: Number of usable repositories \( |\mathcal{R}_{\text{usable}}| \) vs. total \( |\mathcal{R}| \).

primitives.name: Quality Bar Standard
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## THE QUALITY BAR (READ THIS FIRST — IT GOVERNS EVERYTHING) The operator's standard is A+++++ or nothing.
primitives.assumptions: All outputs must meet \( \text{Quality} > \beta \), where \( \beta \) is the threshold for \( \text{A}^{+++++} \).
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \text{Quality} < \beta \), output is rejected and re-evaluated.

layer2.mapping: Standardized quality function \( Q(x) = \text{Grade}(x) \cdot \text{Verification}(x) \), where \( x \in \text{OutputSet} \).
